parts.name: Frame
parts.move: root: the chassis and mast, pushed on its castors

parts.name: Castor_FL
parts.move: swivel about z, free 360 deg

parts.name: Wheel_FL
parts.move: spin about x, rolls r=0.075 m

parts.name: Brake_FL
parts.move: pedal tips about x 0..20 deg: down = wheel locked

parts.name: Castor_FR
parts.move: swivel about z, free 360 deg

parts.name: Wheel_FR
parts.move: spin about x, rolls r=0.075 m

parts.name: Brake_FR
parts.move: pedal tips about x 0..20 deg: down = wheel locked

parts.name: Castor_RL
parts.move: swivel about z, free 360 deg

parts.name: Wheel_RL
parts.move: spin about x, rolls r=0.075 m

parts.name: Brake_RL
parts.move: pedal tips about x 0..20 deg: down = wheel locked

parts.name: Castor_RR
parts.move: swivel about z, free 360 deg

parts.name: Wheel_RR
parts.move: spin about x, rolls r=0.075 m

parts.name: Brake_RR
parts.move: pedal tips about x 0..20 deg: down = wheel locked

parts.name: Carriage
parts.move: slides up z 0..0.25 m on the mast (hydraulic ram), lifts the wheel

parts.name: SpreadCrank
parts.move: turns about x (lead screw): both fork arms move in / out together, 4 mm per turn

parts.name: ForkArm_L
parts.move: slides along x on the beam (lead screw): -0.15 .. -0.35 m from the centre

parts.name: Roller_L
parts.move: spins about y: the tyre turns on it (to line up the wheel with the axle)

parts.name: ForkArm_R
parts.move: slides along x on the beam (lead screw): 0.15 .. 0.35 m from the centre

parts.name: Roller_R
parts.move: spins about y: the tyre turns on it (to line up the wheel with the axle)

parts.name: PumpPedal
parts.move: tips about x 0..25 deg: each stroke raises the carriage about 8 mm

parts.name: ReleaseValve
parts.move: turns about the panel normal 0..270 deg: open: the carriage comes down slowly
